answer: The filter I would set is signed co-working desk booking streak with venue attestation. A co-working venue signs a sixty-day desk booking streak for the member. A farm needs one real member showing up per copy, and a streak with no bookings is an empty history. One haven is a small errand for a real participant, but the signal has to be paid again for each identity, and the fable left is whatever survives paying it a thousand times.
